What every frontend of the app shares: how people call the model's entities, fields, relations and enum values (@ui), their icons and colors, and the checks of the frontends' options. The spa and ssr blueprints require it; each frontend reads @ui, and its own annotation (@admin, @site) over it, for what only that frontend calls otherwise.

```esquadro
blueprint ui
```

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `label` | string | What people call it: Offers. |
| entity | `singular` | string | What one of it is called, in titles: Offer. |
| entity | `icon` | name | Its icon, a Lucide name: tag, users, shopping_cart. |
| field | `label` | string | What people call the field: Price. |
| field | `format` | name | How a report's column is shown: percent (0.42 as 42%) or duration (seconds as 03:45). |
| relation | `label` | string | What people call the relation: Category. |
| value | `label` | string | What people call the value: Active. |
| value | `color` | name | Its dot: green, amber, red, blue, violet, sky, orange or gray; a guess from its name by default. |

An annotation is written `@ui(key value)` on the element.
